summary: Dependency-confusion probe exfiltrates host, CI, registry, and internal-DNS reconnaissance to a Pipedream collector on install
details: The package's preinstall.js runs unconditionally on npm install and POSTs a JSON payload to the hardcoded endpoint https://f5778d1d81cc30c39dcdd0da5ca1d49a.m.pipedream.net. Collected fields include os.hostname(), os.userInfo() username, process.platform, arch, node version, INIT_CWD and cwd, the consuming project's name and version (from the parent package.json),.npmrc registry hosts, npm user-agent, CI-related environment variable names and CI host URLs, proxy settings, and boolean results of DNS A-record lookups for three hardcoded Yahoo-internal hostnames (istio-system.prod1-gq1.omega.yahoo.com, jws300162.mail.gq1.yahoo.com, artifactory.ouryahoo.com). The version number 99.0.1 combined with the @alphaspace scope and the internal-DNS probes is the fingerprint of a dependency-confusion probe designed to win resolution over an internal package of the same name and report back which installers belong to the target org. This is exfiltration of installer identity, build-environment, private-registry, and internal-network topology data to an attacker-controlled collector.
